title: Sarwar ka Badan Channi Channi Sar Peet ke Khawar Rone Lagi
body:
Sarwar ka badan chhalni chhalni sar peet ke qahar rone lagi
Bekas thi bahen laashe pe khadi ye dekh ke manzar rone lagi
Qasim ki nirali shaadi hai dono ki taraf barbadi hai, shabbir ki beti jo thi dulhan laashe pa tadap ke rone lagi
Asghar ne labon par sookhi zuban darya ki taraf hanskar pheri, dekhi na gayi jab tashna labi har mouj tadap kar rone lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar ka jigar dekha chhalni begor-o-kafan lasha tha wahin, baithoongi na main saye me kabhi kah kah ye madar rone lagi
Ammu main abhi tak pyasi hoon khakar main tamachey aayi hoon, lashey pa Sakina karke bayan ruqsaar batkar rone lagi
Seeney pa chadha jab shimr-e-layeen mazloom pa karne zulm-o-jafa, tha khush he pyasa sheh ka gala talwaar laraz kar rone lagi
Khaimoun me saare aag lagi sar se bhi ridayen chhini gayi, begor-o-kafan bhai hai mera Zainab ye kehkar rone lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
Abid ka gala aur tauq-e-garan bimaar larazta tha us aan, zaalim jo pinhaane aage badhey zanjeer tadap kar rone lagi
Dasween ko moharram ki Qasim maqtal mein ajab tha hashr bapa, aye jo Ali to Zainab ye rudaad suna kar rone lagi
